competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to remove 1 beneficial effect each, and inflicts Continuous Damage equal to the number of effects removed for 3 turns.
Attacks all enemies to provoke them for 1 turn with an 80% chance. The damage dealt increases by 20% for each harmful effect granted on the target.
The attack attribute of both crystals and the Boss change randomly among Fire, Water, and Wind at the end of each turn. The defense attribute of the boss does not change. [Automatic Effect]
Increases the damage dealt to the enemy by 300% if two crystals have different attributes. In addition, gains a turn instantly when the crystals are attacked 10 times. [Automatic Effect]
